Link test: → christ (Israel, God's son, read as a figure of the Messiah; cf. Hos 11:1 / Matt 2:15) still reads true; → the-one-true-church still reads true and is exactly what §60 says. proposals.new_description: The people descended from Abraham, Isaac and Jacob whom God chose as his own possession and formed at Sinai, also called by the poetic title Jeshurun, 'the upright one' (Deut 7:6; 32:15; Isa 44:2).

proposals.reasoning: The 'assembly of the Chosen People before God', above all at Sinai where Israel 'was established by God as his holy people', is Israel convoked as God's people (the qahal).
